notes: §1985:VI.6.5.2 prints Format 1, ACCEPT identifier-1 [FROM mnemonic-name-1], and Format 2, ACCEPT identifier-2 FROM one of DATE, DAY, DAY-OF-WEEK or TIME. acceptStatement parses one receiving identifier and an optional FROM acceptSource whose alternatives are those four words and one word for the mnemonic-name; BindAccept routes a temporal source to Format 2 and BindAcceptFromMnemonic with MnemonicDevice requires the word to be a SPECIAL-NAMES mnemonic-name (COBOL0817). The later editions' additions are refused at 85: DATE YYYYMMDD, DAY YYYYDDD and END-ACCEPT by VisitAcceptStatement (COBOL0815, COBOL0816), the screen format's positioning phrase by ScreenFormatOf (COBOL1707) and an ON EXCEPTION phrase on a device ACCEPT by DeviceFormatPhrase (COBOL2269). Probed at --std 85: both formats with a subscripted and a reference-modified receiver run; two receivers, no receiver, a literal, FROM with no operand or two, a subscripted mnemonic-name and an undeclared device word are refused. The witness runs the four Format 2 sources and compiles both Format 1 forms.

[ END-ACCEPT ]; plus Format 3 (screen): ACCEPT screen-name-1 ...". 2023 keeps both 1985 formats but adds the YYYYMMDD and YYYYDDD phrases, END-ACCEPT and a screen format.
